EDS is the unified digital platform that powers GE HealthCare’s global software portfolio. It brings together reusable UI components, design patterns and accessibility standards to connect user experience and engineering.

By encouraging teams to reduce, reuse and recycle, EDS helps product teams eliminate redundant work and build consistent, accessible applications. These foundational components support clinical and operational applications and allow teams to focus on patient safety.

**The opportunity**

We are looking for a Software Engineer to build and maintain reusable components for the Ethos Design System. As EDS grows across GE HealthCare’s product portfolio, you will help make its components easy for teams to discover, integrate and use.

You will work with senior engineers, architects, UX designers, product owners, Lead System Designers, DevOps and quality engineers. You will own assigned components and features from implementation through testing, documentation and maintenance, with support and guidance from senior team members.

### **Component engineering and API design**

* Develop and maintain reusable, encapsulated UI components using Lit and Web Components.

### **Design fidelity and accessibility**

* Work closely with UX designers to understand component appearance, behavior and interaction states.
